hintChesedAfter.text: The next base is in Gevurah. General Crane holds it.

hintGevurah.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurah.text: General Crane holds the base here in Gevurah.

hintGevurah.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurah.text: The door won't open for you until you have the Legion of Merit, from General Morrow in Chesed.

hintGevurah.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurah.text: Bring Shackles. An arrest is better for your name than an execution.

hintGevurahAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurahAfter.text: General Crane is beaten. You have the Distinguished Flying Cross.

hintGevurahAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurahAfter.text: The next base is in Binah. General Blackwood holds it.

hintBinah.speaker: townsman
hintBinah.text: General Blackwood holds the base here in Binah.

hintBinah.speaker: townsman
hintBinah.text: The door won't open for you until you have the Distinguished Flying Cross, from General Crane in Gevurah.

hintBinah.speaker: townsman
hintBinah.text: Bring Shackles. An arrest is better for your name than an execution.

hintBinahAfter.speaker: townsman
hintBinahAfter.text: General Blackwood is beaten. You have the Distinguished Service Cross.

hintBinahAfter.speaker: townsman
hintBinahAfter.text: The next base is in Chokmah. General Sorrel holds it.

hintChokmah.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmah.text: General Sorrel holds the base here in Chokmah.

hintChokmah.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmah.text: The door won't open for you until you have the Distinguished Service Cross, from General Blackwood in Binah.

hintChokmah.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmah.text: Bring Shackles. An arrest is better for your name than an execution.

hintChokmahAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmahAfter.text: General Sorrel is beaten. You have the Golden Shackles.

hintChokmahAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmahAfter.text: Nero's palace in Keter will open for you now.

wynFirst.speaker: wyn
wynFirst.text: Quiet, please. This is the last library in Sorrow County. The army burned the rest.

wynFirst.speaker: wyn
wynFirst.text: I'm Archivist Wyn. I write down every CryMon anyone has ever caught.

wynFirst.speaker: wyn
wynFirst.text: You carry a CryDex? Good. Fill it. Every time you catch more kinds, come show me.

wynFirst.speaker: wyn
wynFirst.text: Ten kinds, twenty-five, fifty, eighty, and every last one. I pay for each.

wynDex10.speaker: wyn
wynDex10.text: Ten kinds already. You have good eyes.

wynDex25.speaker: wyn
wynDex25.text: Twenty-five! Most trainers never see that many.

wynDex50.speaker: wyn
wynDex50.text: Fifty kinds. Half the county's CryMon, in one girl's book.

wynDex80.speaker: wyn
wynDex80.text: Eighty. I've waited forty years to read a list this long.

wynDexAll.speaker: wyn
wynDexAll.text: I'll copy your CryDex into the library's great book. Your name goes on the first page.

wynNeed10.speaker: wyn
wynNeed10.text: Show me ten kinds caught. The grass here has Runemotes, Crymares and Glasswisps.

wynNeed25.speaker: wyn
wynNeed25.text: Twenty-five kinds next. Every patch of tall grass has its own three.

wynNeed50.speaker: wyn
wynNeed50.text: Fifty kinds next. The Sephirot cities north of the Veil have grass you've never seen.

wynNeed80.speaker: wyn
wynNeed80.text: Eighty kinds next. Some only grow up by evolving. Train them.

wynNeedAll.speaker: wyn
wynNeedAll.text: Only a few kinds left. Look at your CryDex. The blank rows are what's missing.

wynDone.speaker: wyn
wynDone.text: Your name is on the first page. Come read it any time.

larkLore.speaker: lark
larkLore.text: I'm Lark, Wyn's helper. The old books are safer than the streets.

larkLore.speaker: lark
larkLore.text: Before the war, these lands were towns along the Sephirot. Nero's queen died twelve years ago, and the Army marched north from here.

larkLore.speaker: lark
larkLore.text: There are nine General-held cities below Keter, from Malkuth at the root to Chokmah near the crown. Nero rules from Keter itself.

larkLore.speaker: max
larkLore.text: So the road ends with him.

larkLore.speaker: lark
larkLore.text: If you survive all nine Generals, yes.

larkLore2.speaker: lark
larkLore2.text: You made it north. Then you know the books were right: every General had someone or something they couldn't let go.

larkLore2.speaker: lark
larkLore2.text: Harrow, Ashgrove, Stroud, Vale, Kessler, Morrow, Crane, Blackwood and Sorrel. Nine walls between CryTown and Nero.

larkLore2.speaker: lark
larkLore2.text: The last General before the crown. After her, only Keter.

hollisRest.speaker: hollis
hollisRest.text: Welcome to the Ruins Inn. Only inn west of CryTown, so don't complain about the beds.

hollisRest.speaker: none
hollisRest.text: Max rests. The CryMon sleep. Everyone wakes up healed.

hollisRest.speaker: hollis
hollisRest.text: Free for you. The whole Ruins knows who beat the soldiers at the gate.

quillReach.speaker: quill
quillReach.text: I'm Quill. I walk the county and hear everything.

quillReach.speaker: quill
quillReach.text: The man in white who broke out of the rock went west to the Reach. He's waiting for someone. Maybe you.

quillCrypt.speaker: quill
quillCrypt.text: Lights under the northwest house here in the Ruins. Somebody's living in the old crypt now.

quillInes.speaker: quill
quillInes.text: You're working for the man in white? Then you want graves.

quillInes.speaker: quill
quillInes.text: There's a grave in the southeast corner of these Ruins. No name on it, fresh flowers every spring.

quillTomas.speaker: quill
quillTomas.text: The Prison yard in the Grove has a grave by the east wall. Soldiers won't go near it.

quillOriel.speaker: quill
quillOriel.text: There's a grave in the Marsh, down in the southwest by the reeds.

quillShrines.speaker: quill
quillShrines.text: The three old shrines? Top of the Cliffs, the middle of the Quarry, and deep in the east of the Forest.

quillHall.speaker: quill
quillHall.text: The house in the northeast of the Reach. The haunted one. Three things wail in there at night.

quillVesk.speaker: quill
quillVesk.text: You look like someone with bones in her bag. Take them back to the crypt. Be ready for a fight.

quillDone.speaker: quill
quillDone.text: The Veil is gone. Everybody's heard. North is where the story is now.

brannAsk.speaker: brann
brannAsk.text: Shut the door. Are you Army?

brannAsk.speaker: max
brannAsk.text: No. I'm from CryTown. I'm trying to free it.

brannAsk.speaker: brann
brannAsk.text: Then we're on the same side. I'm Brann. I marched for Nero for twenty years before I saw what he did to the dead.

brannAsk.speaker: brann
brannAsk.text: My brother Marn lives in Malkuth. I haven't spoken to him in twelve years.

brannAsk.speaker: brann
brannAsk.text: If you reach him, tell him I'm alive. Take this letter.

brannWait.speaker: brann
brannWait.text: Malkuth is the first city past the Weeping Road. Marn is the old man everyone goes to for advice.

brannReply.speaker: brann
brannReply.text: That's Marn's handwriting. He still calls me Brannie.

brannReply.speaker: max
brannReply.text: He wanted to know you were alive.

brannReply.speaker: brann
brannReply.text: You carried a deserter's letter through the war. Take Tusk. He got me out once; now he's yours.

brannAfter.speaker: brann
brannAfter.text: Tusk is happier with you. He hates sitting still.

brannAfter.speaker: brann
brannAfter.text: If you meet Nero, don't look at the queen's ring. He thinks she's still wearing it.

marnLetter.speaker: marn
marnLetter.text: A letter? From Brann? My brother Brann?

marnLetter.speaker: marn
marnLetter.text: He's alive. Twelve years I thought Nero had him bound in the Veil.

marnLetter.speaker: marn
marnLetter.text: Wait here. I'm writing back. Take this to him, and tell him to eat something.

oskOne.speaker: osk
oskOne.text: A child in the Reach who made it this far. Good. I'm Osk.

oskOne.speaker: osk
oskOne.text: I teach three things: dodge, block, barrier. Speed avoids a hit, strength meets it, magic protects against it.

oskOneWin.speaker: osk
oskOneWin.text: Good. You didn't panic. Come back when you've beaten Lieutenant Lead. I'll use my real team.

oskTwoWait.speaker: osk
oskTwoWait.text: My real team is for someone who has beaten Lieutenant Lead. Go north first.

oskTwo.speaker: osk
oskTwo.text: Lead is down? Then you've learned what six CryMon can do when a trainer stops holding back.

oskTwo.speaker: max
oskTwo.text: I learned enough to keep moving.

oskTwoWin.speaker: osk
oskTwoWin.text: Well done. One more lesson, when you carry the medal of the last General. Then I have nothing left to teach.

oskThreeWait.speaker: osk
oskThreeWait.text: The last lesson is for someone holding all nine medals. Come back then.

oskThree.speaker: max
oskThree.text: Then train me for the last fight.

oskThree.speaker: osk
oskThree.text: Fight me as if the King were standing here. No mercy, no excuses.

oskThreeWin.speaker: osk
oskThreeWin.text: That's it. There's nothing I can show you that Nero won't.

oskThreeWin.speaker: none
oskThreeWin.text: Max got a Perfect Crystal and 3 Panaceas.

oskDone.speaker: osk
oskDone.text: Go on. Keter is waiting. I'll be here, knocking down the next one.

ilseLore.speaker: ilse
ilseLore.text: Sit. I'm Ilse. People call me the Sage because I've been explaining crystals longer than you've been alive.

ilseLore.speaker: ilse
ilseLore.text: Each CryMon carries a crystal type, and the type decides what harms or resists it.

ilseLore.speaker: ilse
ilseLore.text: Ruby burns, Sapphire freezes, Emerald grows, Jasper buries, Citrine strikes, Obsidian swallows, Prism masters fire, ice and lightning, and Diamond breaks Jasper.

ilseLore.speaker: ilse
ilseLore.text: Quartz is plain. It neither wins nor loses by type.

ilseLore.speaker: max
ilseLore.text: And if I learn the matchups?

ilseLore.speaker: ilse
ilseLore.text: Half the battle is knowing what not to hit.

ilseBadges.speaker: ilse
ilseBadges.text: Both of the Reach's badges? Quartz and Opal don't give those out lightly.

ilseBadges.speaker: ilse
ilseBadges.text: Here. I cut this one myself, forty years ago. It's time it caught something.

ilseHint.speaker: ilse
ilseHint.text: Win both of the Reach's badges, Quartz's and Opal's, and come back. I have something for you.

ilseHint.speaker: ilse
ilseHint.text: Want the crystals again? Ruby burns, Sapphire freezes, Emerald grows, Jasper buries, Citrine strikes, Obsidian swallows, Prism masters, Diamond falls.

ilseAgain.speaker: ilse
ilseAgain.text: Hit the weakness and a fight is half as long. Walk into a resist and it's twice as long. That's all the wisdom I have.

marenAsk.speaker: none
marenAsk.text: A cold spot moves beside the bed. A girl made of mist looks up at Max.

marenAsk.speaker: maren
marenAsk.text: You can see me? Nobody has since the soldiers came.

marenAsk.speaker: maren
marenAsk.text: I'm Maren. I got sick the winter the Army came through. A man in grey came after. He said I had to stay.

marenAsk.speaker: maren
marenAsk.text: Yes. The soldiers threw my doll into the Marsh. I can't leave without it.

marenWait.speaker: maren
marenWait.text: My doll is in the Marsh. North end, by the water. Please.

marenRest.speaker: maren
marenRest.text: I can. And Frost can leave too. She stayed because I couldn't.

dollFound.speaker: none
dollFound.text: A rag doll lies in the reeds, soaked through. A button for one eye.

emptyQuiet.speaker: none
emptyQuiet.text: The house is cold. Nobody lives here any more.

postGameHome.speaker: none
postGameHome.text: Max wakes up in her own bed in CryTown. The war is over. The roads are still open.

postGameHome.speaker: none
postGameHome.text: Save to keep playing. Calder has been asking for Max at the east gate.

calderPostFight.speaker: calder
calderPostFight.text: The army's gone. No camp, no orders, no pay.

calderPostFight.speaker: calder
calderPostFight.text: I've been training on this road every day since you walked past me. One more fight. A real one.

calderPostWin.speaker: none
calderPostWin.text: Calder drops to one knee, grinning.

calderPostWin.speaker: calder
calderPostWin.text: That's twice. I'll stop counting now.

calderPostDone.speaker: calder
calderPostDone.text: I'm heading to Malkuth. Hale says the new guard needs people who can take a hit.

crierPostTrial.speaker: crier
crierPostTrial.text: News from CryTown! The Weeping King stood trial in Malkuth. Guilty on every count!

crierPostTrial.speaker: crier
crierPostTrial.text: The north road is open for good. Traders are already coming south.

crierPostCrown.speaker: crier
crierPostCrown.text: News from CryTown! Nero is dead and Queen Max sits the throne in Keter!

crierPostCrown.speaker: crier
crierPostCrown.text: Nobody's sure whether to cheer or keep their heads down. I'm doing both.

hintMalkuthPost.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuthPost.text: The base is empty now. Somebody painted flowers on the gate.

hintYesodPost.speaker: townsman
hintYesodPost.text: They're melting down the army's crystals for new lamps. Yesod has never been this bright.

hintNetzachPost.speaker: townswoman
hintNetzachPost.text: The prisoners from the camp came home last week. My brother among them.

hintHodPost.speaker: townsman
hintHodPost.text: Hod has a market again. First one in twelve years.

hintTiferetPost.speaker: townswoman
hintTiferetPost.text: Every city sends someone to Tiferet now. They talk instead of fight. Mostly.

hintChesedPost.speaker: townsman
hintChesedPost.text: The soldiers who stayed are rebuilding what they burned. It's a start.

hintGevurahPost.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurahPost.text: Gevurah's forges make plows now. Loud ones, but plows.

hintBinahPost.speaker: townsman
hintBinahPost.text: The old Weeping flags make good blankets. Warm, too.

hintChokmahPost.speaker: townswoman
hintChokmahPost.text: We keep a candle in the window for the ones who never came back from the war.

hintKeterPost.speaker: elder
hintKeterPost.text: The palace is quiet. For the first time in my life, Keter just feels like a city.

marnPost.speaker: marn
marnPost.text: Twelve years of war, and a girl from CryTown broke its grip. Malkuth won't forget you.

marnPost.speaker: max
marnPost.text: Then help me make sure the freedom lasts.

dagnyAsk.speaker: dagny
dagnyAsk.text: Foreman Dagny. Something in this quarry keeps chewing through my blasting fuses.

dagnyAsk.speaker: dagny
dagnyAsk.text: You know it? Catch one in the grass and show me. I want proof before I change the whole crew's routine.

dagnyThanks.speaker: dagny
dagnyThanks.text: So that's the little fuse-eater. Smaller than I thought. Meaner, too.

dagnyThanks.speaker: dagny
dagnyThanks.text: Keep it. Take these for your trouble.

dagnyAfter.speaker: dagny
dagnyAfter.text: We wrap the fuses in wet cloth now. The Cindermites hate it.

fenwickAsk.speaker: townsman
fenwickAsk.text: Old Fenwick. Forty years fishing this marsh, and now something freezes my lines solid.

fenwickAsk.speaker: townsman
fenwickAsk.text: If that's what it is, catch one and show me. Then I'll know what I'm dealing with.

fenwickThanks.speaker: townsman
fenwickThanks.text: A Chillnewt! So you're the one stealing my bait.

fenwickThanks.speaker: townsman
fenwickThanks.text: Here. Linen wraps. I keep more than I need.

fenwickAfter.speaker: townsman
fenwickAfter.text: I fish on the warm side now. The Chillnewts can have the cold water.

hollowLocked.speaker: none
hollowLocked.text: Thick brambles choke the western path. Past them, something hums in the dark.

hollowLocked.speaker: max
hollowLocked.text: Not now. There's still a war to finish.

hollowKeeperMeet.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperMeet.text: So the brambles finally let someone through.

hollowKeeperMeet.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperMeet.text: This is the Hollow. Sephirot light spilled here during the war and changed everything that drank it.

hollowKeeperMeet.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperMeet.text: Three fighters stayed to test themselves against what grew here. Beat the Ranger, the Shade and the Warden, then come back.

hollowKeeperMeet.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperMeet.text: I keep the fire. If you survive the grass, you'll be welcome beside it.

hollowKeeperHint.speaker: none
hollowKeeperHint.text: The Keeper's fire warms the party back to full.

hollowKeeperHint.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperHint.text: The Ranger and the Shade first. The Warden won't fight anyone who hasn't.

hollowKeeperReward.speaker: none
hollowKeeperReward.text: The Keeper's fire warms the party back to full.

hollowKeeperReward.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperReward.text: You beat the Warden. Nobody's done that in the years I've kept this place.

hollowKeeperReward.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperReward.text: Take these. Something rare lives in this grass. Don't let it get away.

hollowKeeperDone.speaker: none
hollowKeeperDone.text: The Keeper's fire warms the party back to full.

hollowKeeperDone.speaker: hollowKeeper
hollowKeeperDone.text: The grass is quieter since you came. Or maybe the monsters just learned your name.

hollowRangerFight.speaker: hollowRanger
hollowRangerFight.text: I followed a Gallowcrow in here three winters ago. It's mine now. I'm its, too.

hollowRangerFight.speaker: hollowRanger
hollowRangerFight.text: Leave? Out there nothing hits back this hard. Show me.

hollowRangerWin.speaker: hollowRanger
hollowRangerWin.text: Ha. Three winters, and you walk in and do that.

hollowRangerAfter.speaker: hollowRanger
hollowRangerAfter.text: The Shade is by the south grass. Don't look it in the eyes. Or do. It doesn't care.

hollowShadeFight.speaker: hollowShade
hollowShadeFight.text: You're warm. Nothing in the Hollow is warm.

hollowShadeFight.speaker: hollowShade
hollowShadeFight.text: Stay. Fight. It's the only thing that still feels like anything.

hollowShadeWin.speaker: hollowShade
hollowShadeWin.text: That felt like something. Thank you.

hollowShadeAfter.speaker: hollowShade
hollowShadeAfter.text: The Warden waits in the west. It remembers when this place was a garden.

hollowWardenWait.speaker: hollowWarden
hollowWardenWait.text: The Ranger. The Shade. Then me. That's the order the Hollow keeps.

hollowWardenFight.speaker: hollowWarden
hollowWardenFight.text: You beat them both. Then you've earned the last fight in this county.

hollowWardenFight.speaker: hollowWarden
hollowWardenFight.text: I kept this garden before the light fell in. Now I keep what grew from it.

hollowWardenWin.speaker: hollowWarden
hollowWardenWin.text: The garden chose well. Go back to the Keeper.

hollowWardenAfter.speaker: hollowWarden
hollowWardenAfter.text: Walk the grass as long as you like. It will always give you a fight.

mercyDismissLines: I can't believe I was beaten by a kid.
Impossible! I've never lost a battle!
